nodes.summary: Let $N, M : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$. If $N(g) = M(g)$ for all sufficiently large $g$, then $N$ and $M$ have the same abstract Ihara constant. In particular, changing finitely many values of $N$ does not change its abstract Ihara constant.
nodes.title: The abstract Ihara constant ignores finitely many values

nodes.summary: Let $N, M : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and $G \in \mathbb{N}$. If $N(g) = M(g)$ for every $g \ge G$, then $N$ and $M$ have the same abstract Ihara constant.
nodes.title: Agreement from an index onward preserves the abstract Ihara constant

nodes.summary: Let $N : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, $c \in [0, \infty]$ and $d \in [0, \infty)$. If $N(g) \le c \cdot g + d$ in $[0, \infty]$ for all sufficiently large $g$, then the abstract Ihara constant of $N$ is at most $c$.
nodes.title: Eventual affine upper bound on the abstract Ihara constant

nodes.summary: Let $N : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and $c \in [0, \infty]$. If $N(g) \le c \cdot g$ in $[0, \infty]$ for all sufficiently large $g$, then the abstract Ihara constant of $N$ is at most $c$.
nodes.title: Eventual linear upper bound on the abstract Ihara constant

nodes.summary: Let $N : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and $c \in [0, \infty]$. If the normalized ratio of $N$ at $g$ is at most $c$ for all sufficiently large $g$, then the abstract Ihara constant of $N$ is at most $c$.
nodes.title: Eventual ratio bounds bound the abstract Ihara constant

nodes.summary: Let $N, M : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$. If $N(g) \le M(g)$ for all sufficiently large $g$, then the abstract Ihara constant of $N$ is at most that of $M$.
nodes.title: Monotonicity of the abstract Ihara constant

nodes.summary: For a sequence $N : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, the abstract Ihara constant of $N$ is $\limsup_{g \to \infty} N(g)/g \in [0, \infty]$, the limit superior as $g \to \infty$ of the normalized ratios of $N$.
nodes.title: Abstract Ihara constant of a sequence

nodes.summary: Let $N : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, $g \in \mathbb{N}$ and $c \in [0, \infty]$. If $N(g) \le c \cdot g$ in $[0, \infty]$, then the normalized ratio of $N$ at $g$ is at most $c$.
nodes.title: Linear upper bound on a normalized ratio

nodes.summary: Let $N, M : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and $g \in \mathbb{N}$. If $N(g) \le M(g)$, then the normalized ratio of $N$ at $g$ is at most the normalized ratio of $M$ at $g$.
nodes.title: Monotonicity of the normalized ratio

nodes.summary: For a sequence $N : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and $g \in \mathbb{N}$, the normalized ratio of $N$ at $g$ is the extended nonnegative real $N(g)/g$ when $g > 0$, and $0$ when $g = 0$.
nodes.title: Normalized Ihara ratio

nodes.summary: Let $N : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$ and $c \in [0, \infty]$. If there are infinitely many integers $g > 0$ with $c \cdot g \le N(g)$ in $[0, \infty]$, then $c \le \limsup_{g \to \infty} N(g)/g$, the Ihara constant of $N$, where the ratio $N(g)/g$ is taken in $[0, \infty]$ and set to $0$ at $g = 0$.
nodes.title: Lower bound for the Ihara constant from a linear bound

nodes.summary: Let $N : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, let $c \in [0, \infty]$, and for each $g \in \mathbb{N}$ let $r_N(g) \in [0, \infty]$ be the normalized ratio $N(g)/g$, with $r_N(0) = 0$. If $c \le r_N(g)$ for infinitely many $g$, then $c \le \limsup_{g \to \infty} r_N(g)$, the Ihara constant of $N$.
nodes.title: Lower bound for the Ihara constant from the normalized ratios

nodes.summary: Let $N : \mathbb{N} \to \mathbb{N}$, $c \in [0, \infty]$ and $g > 0$ an integer. If $c \cdot g \le N(g)$ in $[0, \infty]$, then $c \le N(g)/g$, where the normalized ratio $N(g)/g$ is taken in $[0, \infty]$.
nodes.title: Lower bound for one normalized Ihara ratio

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
